title: Reefer Cargo Services: Goodwill Waiver Authority and Allowances
content:
The service desk's discretion to forgive a Reefer Cargo Services fee as a gesture of goodwill is bounded by three tier figures: the largest single fee row the desk may forgive, the number of goodwill waivers one customer may receive on reefer services within any trailing 365 calendar days, and the number of calendar days after a fee was booked during which such a waiver may still be asked for.

| Tier | Largest fee row the desk may forgive (USD) | Goodwill waivers per customer in 365 days | Request window after the fee was booked (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 0.00 | 0 | 30 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 50.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 100.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 150.00 | 2 | 45 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 200.00 | 2 | 45 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 150.00 | 1 | 30 |

## How to read the figures

- The authority figure is a limit per fee row, not per service or per call.
- The allowance is a count per customer over a trailing span of 365 calendar days, not a count per service.
- The window is measured in calendar days from the booking of the fee concerned.

## Observations

- On Standard both the authority and the allowance are zero, so the desk has no goodwill waiver to give on that tier even though a 30-day window is shown.
- Controlled Atmosphere and Pharma GDP are the tiers with a 45-day window and an allowance of two.
